description: Copy a URL to the clipboard and trigger ytDownloader's global hotkey to download it.

3. In the extension, add this command:
native-client is the local host that lets the extension run that command. ytdownloader-caller copies the URL to the clipboard, starts ytdownloader when it is not running, then presses Ctrl+Shift+D.
Enable the global hotkey in ytDownloader preferences (default Ctrl+Shift+D); otherwise the keystroke does nothing.
